engineeringSkip.reason: A buzzword mash-up with no basis in known physics: room-temperature quantum coherence in a bulk structural material enabling zero-friction bearings and 'perfect superconductors' is not a real research programme.

factCheck.reason: Fermion superfluidity and quantum coherence require temperatures near absolute zero, so a bulk solid that stays superfluid at room temperature contradicts established physics, and 'fermion-condensate composites' is a mash-up of unrelated quantum ideas rather than a real material class.
